account: Giovanni Abitante used generative video to animate Dorothea Lange’s photographs and reconstruct scenes for I Am an American, a short film about the wartime incarceration of Japanese Americans. In a July 2025 festival interview, he described AI as a production technique within a project that depended on archival research and writing. PerSo’s program lists the film and its recorded testimony. The evidence establishes a completed creative work and public exhibition, not a measured improvement in historical understanding or audience engagement.

fields.account: Giovanni Abitante used generative video to animate Dorothea Lange’s photographs and reconstruct scenes for I Am an American, a short film about the wartime incarceration of Japanese Americans. In a July 2025 festival interview, he described AI as a production technique within a project that depended on archival research and writing. PerSo’s program lists the film and its recorded testimony. The evidence establishes a completed creative work and public exhibition, not a measured improvement in historical understanding or audience engagement.
